_comment: PA1 PII linter hook for Claude Code.
Install: copy this file to ~/.claude/settings.json (user-wide) or
.claude/settings.json (per-project) and merge with your existing config.
PostToolUse: after Claude writes/edits a file, scan it. Exit 2 on HIGH+
to block the tool result and force Claude to redact.
Stop:        at end-of-turn, scan the working tree. Exit 2 to force
Claude to continue and clean up before signing off.
Scope matcher (PostToolUse|Write|.*) means every Write/Edit/MultiEdit tool
call. Adjust if you have other tools named Write/Edit.

hooks.command: bash -c 'f="$CLAUDE_TOOL_FILE_PATH"; case "$f" in *.csv|*.jsonl|*.md) pa1-lint scan -- "$f" || exit 2;; esac'
